steps.caption: A leaked token from the SpotBugs project is used to compromise reviewdog/action-setup@v1.
tj-actions/eslint-changed-files depends on reviewdog/action-setup, so the compromise moves one hop.
From there the attackers reach tj-actions/changed-files, an action used by 23,000+ repositories.
The initial target was Coinbase's agentkit repository.
Most victims never referenced the compromised action directly. That hidden depth is what ChainBreaker maps.
